skill.name: lead-magnets
skill.description: Plans lead magnets for email capture, lead generation, and product education. It helps choose formats, gates, distribution channels, and measurement plans.
skill.summary: Create practical lead magnet strategies that attract qualified subscribers and connect to product adoption.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

content.value_statement: Teams need useful offers that collect qualified emails without wasting production time. This skill turns audience, content, and channel details into a focused lead magnet plan.
actual_capabilities: Recommends lead magnet formats based on buyer stage, audience, and effort.
Defines gating approach, form fields, delivery method, and landing page sections.
Builds promotion plans across blog CTAs, popups, social channels, partners, and paid channels.
Selects KPIs and A/B tests for conversion rate and lead quality.
Uses benchmark ranges for conversion, cost, timelines, and lead quality signals.
limitations: It does not write the final ebook, template, or email copy.
It does not run ads or configure landing pages.
Benchmark ranges are general and need validation with your own data.
Interactive tool lead magnets need a separate tool strategy.

use_cases.title: Launch a SaaS Content Offer
use_cases.description: Plan a product-aligned template, checklist, or guide that attracts prospects before a demo or trial.

use_cases.title: Package Agency Expertise
use_cases.description: Turn repeatable client advice into a downloadable asset with a clear capture and follow-up path.

use_cases.title: Grow an Email List
use_cases.description: Choose a low-effort offer that fits current content, audience needs, and available promotion channels.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Lead Magnet
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose a lead magnet for [audience]. My product solves [problem], and I can spend [time or budget].

prompt_templates.title: Repurpose Existing Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this existing content into a lead magnet plan: [paste summary]. Recommend the format, gate, landing page sections, and promotion channels.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Full Funnel Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a lead magnet strategy for [buyer stage]. Include offer concept, outline, capture plan, delivery method, distribution, KPIs, and first tests.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Lead Magnet Portfolio
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these lead magnets: [list offers and results]. Identify weak points, audience fit, lead quality issues, and prioritized improvements.

output_examples.input: A B2B SaaS company wants operations managers to start a free trial.
output: Recommended format: implementation checklist for a high-friction workflow.
Gate: email plus role, because buyer fit matters for sales follow-up.
Distribution: product blog CTAs, LinkedIn posts, and retargeting for workflow pages.
Measurement: landing page conversion, trial starts, and lead-to-trial rate.

output_examples.input: An agency has several blog posts about conversion audits.
output: Recommended format: website audit checklist with a one-page scoring guide.
Content outline: traffic quality, offer clarity, form friction, proof, and next steps.
Promotion: post-specific content upgrades and a dedicated landing page.
First test: email-only gate against email plus company website.

best_practices: Start with one specific buyer problem and match the offer to buyer stage.
Ask only for the fields needed to deliver and qualify the offer.
Measure conversion, engagement, and downstream product actions by source.
anti_patterns: Creating a broad ebook when a checklist or template would solve the problem faster.
Asking for many form fields on a low-value top-funnel offer.
Promoting every offer to every channel without matching audience intent.

faq.question: What lead magnet formats does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports checklists, cheat sheets, templates, swipe files, guides, courses, quizzes, webinars, trials, and resource libraries.

faq.question: Can it create the final downloadable asset?
faq.answer: It plans the strategy, structure, and outline. Use a writing or design workflow to produce the finished asset.

faq.question: Does it help with landing pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests landing page sections, form fields, delivery methods, and A/B tests for conversion improvement.

faq.question: Can it plan promotion channels?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers blog CTAs, popups, social posts, partner promotion, paid ads, and retargeting options.

faq.question: Does it include performance benchmarks?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses benchmark ranges for conversion rates, costs, timelines, and lead quality signals.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Marketers, founders, agencies, and creators can use it to plan offers that collect qualified emails.
